scope: invoke the real r_eif_send -> vhci_send C2H path from QEMU
finding: r_eif_send -> vhci_send is the firmware-internal path that invokes the registered notify_host_recv callback, updates VHCI flow state and later calls send-available.

experiment.invocation: QEMU nested guest call at the idle safe point
experiment.guest_error: Guru Meditation Error: Cache disabled but cached memory region accessed

conclusion: The real controller entry cannot be treated as a re-entrant RPC from the QEMU device callback context. Controller delivery must be integrated as a device/IRQ event with valid cache and flow-control context, or replaced by an in-process controller model.
